claims: The Michigan Wolverines have claimed 12 college football national championships in their program history.
The Michigan Wolverines' most recent national championship was in the 2023 season.
The Michigan Wolverines' 2023 season national championship was under coach Jim Harbaugh.
The Michigan Wolverines won the 2024 College Football Playoff (CFP) National Championship.
The Michigan Wolverines defeated Washington 34-13 in the 2024 College Football Playoff (CFP) National Championship.
The Michigan Wolverines finished the season 15-0.
Michigan had key wire-service selections (AP/Coaches) in 1948, 1997, and 2023.
The Michigan Wolverines defeated Washington 34-13 to win their first CFP National Championship in the modern era in the 2023 season (2024 final).
The 1997 Michigan Wolverines season was led by Heisman winner Charles Woodson.
The 1997 Michigan Wolverines was named AP National Champions.
The 1948 Michigan Wolverines season was led by coach Bennie Oosterbaan.
Bennie Oosterbaan was the first coach to win a national title in his debut season.
The 2023 Michigan Wolverines team achieved the first 15-0 record in school history.
Michigan is recognized for having the most all-time wins in college football history.
